mapper.select: SELECT fnd06_office_work_cd AS officeWorkCode , fnd06_office_work_nm AS officeWorkName , fnd06_kofia_cd AS kofiaCode FROM fnd06_office_work WHERE fnd06_company_id = #{companyId} AND fnd06_office_work_use_yn = 'true' AND #{officeWorkCode} = CASE WHEN #{ifCode} = 'SFTP_SHFP_01' THEN fnd06_etc_office_work_cd01 WHEN #{ifCode} = 'SFTP_KBFP_01' THEN fnd06_etc_office_work_cd06 ELSE null END
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fnd06_office_work ( fnd06_office_work_id , fnd06_office_work_cd , fnd06_office_work_nm , fnd06_office_work_use_yn , fnd06_office_work_note , fnd06_company_id , fnd06_etc_office_work_cd01 , fnd06_etc_office_work_cd06 , fnd06_kofia_cd ) VALUES ( f_create_seq() , #{officeWork.officeWorkCode} , #{officeWork.officeWorkName} , 'true' , null , #{companyId} , CASE WHEN #{ifCode} = 'SFTP_SHFP_01' THEN #{ifi30OfficeWorkCode} ELSE null END /*SFTP_SHFP_01:신한펀드파트너스*/ , CASE WHEN #{ifCode} = 'SFTP_KBFP_01' THEN #{ifi30OfficeWorkCode} ELSE null END /*SFTP_KBFP_01:KB펀드파트너스*/ , #{officeWork.kofiaCode} )
